title: SocialCMD
description: Plugin for adding commands that link to your social media accounts, Discord servers, etc.
body:
# SocialCMD
A Minecraft plugin for adding commands that link to your social media accounts, Discord servers, etc.

It's designed to be very lightweight, with the size of >5KB and start time of ~11ms with 2000 commands.

![Output of /discord using the default configuration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/947193165ae3709347ada5d302204eade5f513db.webp)

You can find instructions on how to configure and build the plugin [here](https://git.mreow.org/meow/socialcmd/src/branch/main/README.md)
